# RoniM — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A freelance AI architect who specializes in building professional networks and AI infrastructure for large organizations. The brand identity is sleek and minimal ('lean'), with a strong emphasis on dynamic visual storytelling — featuring scroll-triggered text animations and immersive imagery that reveal content as the user scrolls. The overall vibe is sophisticated, tech-forward, and visually compelling, designed to impress enterprise-level clients.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About RoniM
A freelance AI architect who specializes in building professional networks and AI infrastructure for large organizations. The brand identity is sleek and minimal ('lean'), with a strong emphasis on dynamic visual storytelling — featuring scroll-triggered text animations and immersive imagery that reveal content as the user scrolls. The overall vibe is sophisticated, tech-forward, and visually compelling, designed to impress enterprise-level clients.

## Target Audience
- ארגונים גדולים הזקוקים לרשת מקצועית
- מובילי חדשנות חברות טכנולוגיה

## Industry
AI Architecture & Consulting
